description_expanded: OverviewLittle Beach Chickee – Ground-Floor Beach Retreat with Walk-Out Access!​​​​The Space Little Beach Chickee – Ground-Floor Beach Retreat with Walk-Out Access! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Walk-Out Beach Access – Step outside and head straight to the sugar-white sand Ground-Floor Location – No stairs, easy access, and seamless indoor-outdoor living Large Green Space Just Outside – Perfect for kids to play or relaxing outdoors Gated Community with Private Pool – Peaceful, secure coastal setting King Master Suite + Hall Bunks – Sleeps up to 4 guests Hall Bunk Beds with Sliding Barn Door – Ideal for kids or extra guests Private Patio Seating – Enjoy morning coffee or evenings outdoors Fully Equipped Kitchen – Modern appliances & essentials for home-style meals 2 Adult Bikes Included – Explore Scenic 30A with ease Community Grill Near Pool – Great for casual cookouts Parking for 1 Vehicle – Easy and convenient Cable TV + Smart TV & High-Speed Wi-Fi – Stay connected & entertained Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free stay Welcome to Little Beach Chickee Welcome to Little Beach Chickee, a relaxed and inviting ground-floor beach retreat designed for effortless coastal living. With walk-out access and a large grassy area just outside the door, this condo offers the ultimate convenience for beach days, families, and anyone who loves easy indoor-outdoor flow. Simply step outside, cross the green space, and you’re on the beach in moments. Spend your days enjoying the shoreline, riding bikes along Scenic Highway 30A, or exploring nearby dining and boutique shopping. After a sun-filled day, return to your comfortable beach home to relax on the patio, grill by the pool, or enjoy a quiet evening inside. Inside, the open-concept living space features coastal décor, comfortable seating, and a seamless layout connecting the living room, dining area, and fully equipped kitchen. Whether you’re preparing meals, snacks, or beach-day essentials, everything you need is ready for your stay. Sliding glass doors lead directly to the patio and grassy outdoor area — an ideal setup for families with children or guests who prefer easy access without stairs or elevators. A washer and dryer are conveniently located inside the unit. The king master bedroom offers plush bedding and quality linens for restful nights. Built-in hallway bunk beds with a sliding barn door provide a cozy and functional sleeping space for kids or additional guests, while still allowing privacy when needed. Complimentary bikes are included for exploring Scenic 30A, and a starter kit of essential amenities is provided to help you settle in comfortably from arrival. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (4) Master Bedroom – King bed Hallway Bunks – Twin-over-twin bunk beds (with barn door) We look forward to welcoming you to Little Beach Chickee — your easy, walk-out beach escape!Show less
